# Can I use the app for free?

Yes! When you install DECO, <mark style="color:blue;">**you can start with our Free plan**</mark>. You won’t be charged until you decide to upgrade!

<figure><img src="/files/cHTsEZfos1NAwBVZEob8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

If you have any questions or concerns, [**chat with us here!**](http://go.crisp.chat/chat/embed/?website_id=17e47fa7-bddf-4074-b627-df66a29a740e) **🤗**
